about: Files the date-arithmetic audit marks as a statutory term path that do not reach a working calendar yet. An entry names the change that will take the file and says why it is not taken here. An entry without a named change is not an entry: EveryTermOnTheCalendarTest fails on it, because an allowlist without owners is how thirty-two files reached this repository unexamined.

entries.reason: acceptOffer() proposes `endDateCurrent + N days` for a dependent term and hands it to requestExtension(). It is a statutory end date computed off the calendar, so an offer can propose a Saturday. The fix is one call, TermijnTimerService::rollTermEndFor(), and it belongs to the change that owns the offer rather than to a build fix: routing it here would change what that change's own tests assert about the date it proposes.
